newsitem.title: USA: Utah-Calif. power lines curtailed through May 1.
newsitem.headline: Utah-Calif. power lines curtailed through May 1.

text.p: Maintenance work on the Southern Transmission System, which links the Intermountain Power Plant in Utah to Southern California, will continue through May 1, a spokesman for the plant said Wednesday.
During the current and final leg of the maintenance schedule, the 1,920 megawatt (MW) transmission system will operate at 1,200 MW between 0600 PT and 1900 PT.
One of Intermountain's two 875 MW coal-fired units has been shut for maintenance work since early April and is due to return to service on May 5.
Intermountain is owned by a consortium of mostly municipal utilities including the Los Angeles Department of Water and Power.
